description.zh:
SSL-VPN服务端的名称。

长度为1～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the SSL server.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page in paging query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
SSL-VPN服务端所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the SSL server. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh:
SSL-VPN服务端所属的资源组ID。

SSL-VPN服务端与其关联的VPN网关实例的资源组相同。您可以调用[DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~)接口查询VPN网关实例所属的资源组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL server belongs.

The SSL server belongs to the same resource group as the associated VPN gateway instance. You can call the [DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~) operation to query the resource group ID of the VPN gateway instance.
The ID of the SSL server.
The ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-servers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-server-id vss-bp15j3du13gq1dgey0000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1on0xae9d771ggi0000 --name test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
